summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill orchestrating a three-agent sequential workflow (Research → Writer → Review) for job description generation. It differs semantically and structurally from existing skills: not a Flink streaming job executor, not a Spring Batch configuration resolver, and not a single-agent session lifecycle manager. Peer candidates (decorator instrumentation, AgentOps setup, agent session lifecycle) are complementary setup/observability skills, not competing implementations of the same capability. The candidate represents a novel multi-agent orchestration pattern with specific tool initialization, agent role assignment, and sequential execution constraints that warrant independent persistence.
